title: Baba Vanga predicts his Kalmykia presidency

tellings.quote: And then all of a sudden, she tells me, "Ah, you'll go back home. You'll be the leader. You'll be president there."

plain: Around 1990, a telegram from Bulgaria brought a young man to the blind Bulgarian seer Baba Vanga, and she told him, out of nowhere, "you'll go back home. You'll be the leader. You'll be president there." The man telling it is the one she said it to: he went on to become president of Kalmykia, a small republic inside Russia, in the early 1990s. If true, she saw his future years before it happened.
